tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: Present perfect (have/has + past participle) links the past to now: experience (I have never heard such a voice), a recent result (He has just passed the test), already / yet (Has she left yet?). Past simple is for a finished time: She saw Paul when he was little. Yesterday the ship landed. Never use present perfect with a finished time expression: not I have seen her yesterday.
tasks.q_pl: Present perfect (have/has + past participle) links the past to now: experience (I have never heard such a voice), a recent result (He has just passed the test), already / yet (Has she left yet?). end_good.title: Місію виконано!
end_good.text: Пол бере одну з твоїх мап і довго дивиться на пустелю. «Я її вже бачив, — каже він тихо. — Уві сні. Тепер я знаю, що вона справжня».
end_good.text_pl: Paul bierze jedną z twoich map i długo patrzy na pustynię. „Już ją widziałem — mówi cicho. — We śnie. Teraz wiem, że jest prawdziwa”.
end_good.text_en: Paul picks up one of your maps and looks at the desert for a long time. “I've already seen it,” he says quietly. “In my dreams. Now I know it's real.”

tasks.label: КВЕСТ

tasks.q_pl: Późno w nocy Paul puka do twoich drzwi: „Nie mogę spać. Porozmawiaj ze mną”. Pyta o twoje doświadczenia — i o to, co już się dziś wydarzyło.
tasks.q_en: Late at night Paul knocks on your door: “I can't sleep. Talk to me.” He asks about your experience, and about what has already happened today.
